primitives.name: number
primitives.about: A value in a range: a slider, with the value shown beside it; tap the value to type one.
primitives.fields: `value` within `min`..=`max`; `step` snaps it (`null`: continuous); `scale: "log"` spreads the slider by ratio, for a wide range such as a brush size (needs `min` above 0; left out, the slider is linear); `unit` is `none`, `percent` (a 0..=1 value shown as 0–100 %), `pixels` or `degrees`; `enabled: false` greys it out. Values and edits are in the number's own units whatever the scale.
primitives.sends: `number` edits: `begin`, `change` while dragging, then `commit` (or `cancel`); a typed value is one `commit`.

primitives.name: choice
primitives.about: One of several options: segmented for up to 4, a menu for more.
primitives.fields: `value` is the chosen option's `id`; option ids are unique; `enabled: false` greys it out.

primitives.name: section
primitives.about: A titled group of other nodes; the user can collapse it.
primitives.fields: `children` are any nodes; `collapsed` is how it starts.
primitives.sends: nothing itself; its children send their own edits.

primitives.name: item_list
primitives.about: Rows of items such as layers, top to bottom: tap to select, swipe to hide, long-press to rename, drag to reorder.
primitives.fields: each row's `id` is the app's own and unique in the list; `depth` indents it (inside groups); `visible: null` means it can't be hidden; `reorderable` allows dragging.
primitives.sends: `select`, `set_visible`, `rename` and (when reorderable) `move` edits, each one `commit`, naming rows by their `id`.
